CA.rationale: Candidate record pairs content (red) with processing/origin metadata (command_estimate) at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and separate origin/status metadata (history_estimate) are both present for the same node/time, meeting C,O,D requirements.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Text links candidate/current processing labels and origin kinds (e.g. command_estimate) to specific candidate content nodes.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items and attributes (red/blue) at named nodes/times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is recorded separately from the node's content, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report specifies presentation/organization (coordinate orientation, node groupings, origin/branch metadata) for identified contents.
